class.name: Resource
class.brief_description: Base class for data that can be loaded from a resource path.
class.description: Resources have a path and an optional name. Setting either value does not load or save a file.

method.name: GetPath
method.description: Gets the virtual path recorded for this resource.
method.returns: The virtual path, or an empty string if no path is set.

method.name: SetPath
method.description: Sets the virtual path recorded for this resource. Does not move, load, or save a file. An invalid path leaves the old path unchanged.
method.param: A valid virtual path, such as res://Textures/Stone.tex. An empty string clears the path.

method.name: GetName
method.returns: The current name, which may be empty.

method.name: SetName
method.description: Sets the resource name. Does not rename the file.
method.param: The new display name. It may be empty.
